REGISTRY
2953
MEMORANDUM ON THE MOVEMENTS OF LIM GOAN LIANG
OR LIM GOAN LIAN, SUSPECTED JAVANESE COMMUNIST. // p32

Lim Goan Liang or Lim Goan Lian, a Nether-
lands Chinese, first came to the knowledge of the
Shanghai Municipal Police during December 1931,
when an article appearing in the overseas edition
of the N.S.I. newspaper "de Locomotief" of Novem-
ber 14th - 17th, 1931, bearing on this man and his
connections with the Great China Co. Ltd. and cer-
tain Russian Trade representatives in Shanghai, was
brought to our notice.

Enquiries made in Shanghai, however, failed
to confirm this report.

Other information pointed to his close connect-
ion with Soviet Trade Representatives in Paris,
whilst he was also strongly suspected of dissemi-
nating communist propaganda.

Lim Goan Liang arrived in Hongkong from Java
on November 21, 1931 by the s.s. "Tjibadak". Dur-
ing his stay in the colony he resided at the Hong-
kong Hotel and acted in a very suspicious manner.

On November 28, 1931 he sailed by the s.s.
"President Adams" for Manila where it is said that
he has connections with the Pan Pacific Oil Co.

It is reported that he frequently travels
between Java, Hongkong and Amoy, generally employ-
ing the J.C.J. Line.

Reg.

2953
关于疑似爪哇共产党人林元良（Lim Goan Liang）或林元连（Lim Goan Lian）行踪的备忘录。// p32

林元良或林元连，荷属华人，首次进入上海公共租界工部局警务处的视野是在1931年12月，当时我们注意到1931年11月14日至17日出版的荷兰东印度报纸《机车报》（de Locomotief）海外版上刊登了一篇涉及此人及其与上海大中华有限公司（Great China Co. Ltd.）和某些俄国贸易代表之间联系的文章。

然而，在上海进行的调查未能证实这一报告。

其他情报显示他与巴黎的苏联贸易代表关系密切，同时他也被强烈怀疑散布共产主义宣传。

林元良于1931年11月21日乘“芝巴达”号（s.s. "Tjibadak"）轮船从爪哇抵达香港。在港停留期间，他住在香港酒店，行为十分可疑。

1931年11月28日，他乘“亚当斯总统”号（s.s. "President Adams"）轮船前往马尼拉，据说他在那里与泛太平洋石油公司（Pan Pacific Oil Co.）有联系。

据报道，他经常在爪哇、香港和厦门之间往返，通常乘坐J.C.J.航运公司的船只。

January 11 32.

Secret and Confidential

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No.4119 of December 7,1931, containing
information regarding the activities of a Javanese
named Lim Gan Liang, and to inform you that efforts
made to confirm the report that this individual
maintained connections with the Great China Co.Ltd
and certain Russian trade representatives in Shanghai
have proved abortive.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Assistant Commissioner (Special Branch).

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

With reference to the attached letter of December 7,
1931 from the Netherlands Consulate General on the subject of
a Java Chinese named Lim Goan Liang (Liem Goan Lian), deligent
inquiries have failed to trace this individual in Shanghai.
Furthermore there is no one known by this name at either the
local branch of Centrosojus or the Great China Co. Ltd.
In event of any information regarding this individual
being obtained a report will be duly submitted.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 4119.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2117
Date 7. 12. 31

SHANGHAI, 7th December 1931.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that the actions and intentions of a certain Java Chinese Lim Goan Liang (Liem Goan Lian) have given rise to suspicion on the part of Netherlands consular officials.

In the overseas edition of the Netherlands Indian newspaper "de Locomotief" of November 14th - 17th last an article appeared concerning this man and his connections with the Great China Co. Ltd. at Shanghai and certain Russian trade representatives there.

Other information, the source of which is unknown to me, points to close connections with Soviet trade representatives at Paris, while he is also suspected of being a propagandist for communist doctrines.

I am now informed that Lim Goan Liang arrived in Hong-kong from Java per s.s. "Tjibadak" on November 24th last. He stayed at the Hongkong Hotel and changed rooms there at least once. He seems to have acted in a very suspicious manner and carried a pistol under his coat.

He originally planned to sail for Manila on November 27th per s.s. "Empress of Canada", but ultimately sailed per s.s. "President Adams" on November 28th for that port, where he seems to have connections with the Pan Pacific Oil Co.

Liem Goan Liang usually travels between Java-Hongkong-Amoy per s.s. "Tjibadak" and visited Amoy several times.

It

R.C. Alers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

编号 S. B. D. 2117
日期 1931年12月7日

上海，1931年12月7日。

先生，

谨此告知，某位爪哇华人林元良（Liem Goan Lian）的行为和意图已引起荷兰领事官员的怀疑。

在去年11月14日至17日出版的荷兰东印度报纸《机车报》（de Locomotief）海外版上，刊登了一篇关于此人及其与上海大中华有限公司及当地某些俄国贸易代表之间联系的文章。

其他来源我不清楚的情报指出，他与巴黎的苏联贸易代表关系密切，同时他也涉嫌作为共产主义学说的宣传员。

现获悉，林元良于上月24日乘“芝巴达”号（s.s. "Tjibadak"）轮船从爪哇抵达香港。他入住香港酒店，并在那里至少换过一次房间。他的行为似乎非常可疑，并在外套下携带一把手枪。

他原计划于11月27日乘“加拿大皇后”号（s.s. "Empress of Canada"）轮船前往马尼拉，但最终于11月28日乘“亚当斯总统”号（s.s. "President Adams"）轮船前往该港口，他在那里似乎与泛太平洋石油公司有联系。

李元连通常乘“芝巴达”号轮船在爪哇-香港-厦门之间旅行，并曾多次访问厦门。

它

R.C. Alers 先生，
副总监，
刑事科及特别科，
上海。

pages.en:
-2-
It seems unlikely that Liem will visit Shanghai in the
very near future as he arranged for passage to Singapore,
and has probably attended to his business in Manila during
the stay in that port of the s/s "President Adams".
I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Chinese Secretary.

-2-
李（Liem）近期访问上海的可能性似乎不大，因为他已安排前往新加坡的行程，并且在“亚当斯总统”号轮船停靠马尼拉期间，可能已处理了他在该港口的业务。
谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
华务秘书。
